baseline.statistical_unit_rule: one DrawRecord is one draw; SourceObservation rows are provenance and must never inflate n

objective: Estimate false-positive behavior, power, minimum detectable effects and required draw counts for preregistered randomness audits, separately for DLT and SSQ.

success_semantics.phase_pass_means: the research process and evidence are valid and reproducible
success_semantics.phase_pass_does_not_mean: a predictable or non-random signal exists

included: Monte Carlo false-positive and power study
excluded: WebUI, online API, scheduler, database service or production deployment
automatic betting, return claims or claims of approaching 100 percent prediction

pre_gate_readiness.purpose: machine-verifiable P2-00A to P2-01 handoff; not a D2 deliverable and not evidence that G0 or G1 passed

statistical_contract.cross_draw_joint_null: conditional on game, number_space_version and documented_draw_process_version, observed draws are independent across issues and each draw follows its fixed-cardinality without-replacement uniform null
statistical_contract.temporal_null_generation: preserve the exact observed issue calendar, missing issues and generation-segment membership; regenerate numbers only and never synthesize unobserved draws
statistical_contract.documented_process_semantics: documented_draw_process_version represents only publicly evidenced procedure and never asserts unknown physical machine or ball-set identity
statistical_contract.unknown_mechanism_metadata_rule: unknown machine or ball-set metadata blocks mechanism attribution only, not otherwise valid marginal, set or temporal-consistency audits

practical_effect_registry.shared_standardized_scale_rule: allowed only with an invertible preregistered transform and retained thresholds in original units
practical_effect_registry.symmetric_interval_shorthand: delta_min may be used only within one registry entry when its practical-null interval is symmetric around the null value

statistical_contract.delta_star_definition: for each game, generation segment, bias family and effect parameter, the smallest preregistered effect-grid point whose simultaneous 95 percent Monte Carlo power lower confidence band is at least 0.80
statistical_contract.required_n_definition: for each registered effect point, the smallest preregistered sample-size-grid point whose simultaneous 95 percent Monte Carlo power lower confidence band is at least 0.80

monte_carlo_validity.fixed_mode_rule: batch checkpoints never permit data-dependent early stopping with ordinary fixed-sample intervals
monte_carlo_validity.sequential_mode_rule: method must be explicitly named, reproducible and provide time-uniform coverage with frozen maximum budget and error allocation
monte_carlo_validity.power_grid_rule: simultaneous confidence bands or an equivalently valid preregistered gridwise error-allocation method are required across the effect by sample-size grid for delta-star and required-n selection

all_required: 95 percent effect interval lies entirely outside the practical-effect registry interval [practical_null_lower, practical_null_upper] for that effect parameter
at the registered practical-effect boundary, not the observed effect, power at the actual generation-segment sample size has simultaneous 95 percent lower bound at least 0.80
result is not a negative control
100 percent of required sensitivity analyses preserve direction

signal_classification.no_detectable_signal: no candidate_signal exists and the power 95 percent lower bound is at least 0.80 at the registered practical-effect boundary for that effect parameter
signal_classification.indeterminate: no candidate_signal exists and power at the registered practical-effect boundary is below 0.80, or a key Monte Carlo interval exceeds its precision limit

aggregate_rule.candidate_signal: at least one classification unit is candidate_signal
aggregate_rule.no_detectable_signal: every candidate-eligible classification unit is no_detectable_signal
aggregate_rule.indeterminate: all other cases; a powered unit cannot mask an underpowered unit

IN-04.definition: draws mapped to exactly one number-space segment and one draw-process segment

IN-05.definition: forbidden or future-information fields entering a statistical matrix

IN-07.definition: practical-effect registry coverage and dimensional completeness

CAL-01.definition: empirical FWER under registered null worlds
CAL-01.family_scope: union of every primary candidate decision across both games, with per-game diagnostics also reported; samples and effects remain separate
CAL-01.formula: null worlds with at least one false rejection in the acceptance family / total null worlds

CAL-02.definition: key FWER Monte Carlo interval half width

CAL-03.definition: empirical coverage of nominal 95 percent intervals in each registered interval-method and scenario family

CAL-04.note: raw negative-control rejections remain reported and count toward CAL-01

QUAL-01.minimum_rule: every implemented core generator/test path has at least one qualification_positive scenario whose expected result is signed before execution

POW-03.definition: key power Monte Carlo interval half width

POW-04.definition: delta-star rule by bias family and effect parameter
POW-04.rule: smallest registered effect-grid point whose simultaneous 95 percent power lower confidence band passes POW-02, else not_identified_within_effect_grid

POW-05.noncandidate_direction_changes: report but do not fail the phase solely for direction change

POW-06.definition: minimum required draw count coverage by registered effect point
POW-06.selection_rule: smallest registered sample-size-grid point whose simultaneous 95 percent power lower confidence band passes POW-02

REP-01.definition: normalized artifact hash match with identical input, code, environment and seed

REP-02.definition: independent historical deterministic-statistic exact match rate

REP-03.definition: different-seed estimates and simultaneous bands within preregistered joint Monte Carlo tolerance

REP-04.definition: delta-star and required-n replay state and corresponding-grid-step compatibility

COV-04.definition: selective deletion, exploratory-primary mixing and cross-game merging counts

COV-06.definition: prerequisite acceptance gates passing before final accept
COV-06.G6_rule: mechanically derived by final accept after all remaining metrics pass

minimum_requirements: writes only its own review or replay artifacts
task or prompt summary hash recorded
procedural_agent_independence.claim_limit: must not be described as organizational or human independence

role_separation.same_code_replay_semantics: proves reproducibility only; REP-02 additionally requires an independent reference calculation path for critical deterministic statistics

deliverables.definition: human-readable frozen input, statistical-unit, public rule timeline, documented draw-process semantics, mechanism-metadata status and point-in-time use contract with machine-checkable section and assertion IDs
complete machine inventory of input paths, hashes, counts, games, issues, segments and upstream identities

frozen registry of the cross-draw joint null, calendar policy, tests, labels, multiplicity, per-effect-parameter practical-effect thresholds, effect and sample-size grids, qualification positives, seeds, fixed or time-uniform Monte Carlo mode, simultaneous power band, budget and precision rules
acceptance_methods: G3 and G4 registry-result bidirectional set comparison

deliverables.definition: identity, responsibility, conflict declaration and signature record for all required roles
independent pre-result review of nulls, statistics, multiplicity, practical-effect registry, effect and sample-size grids, budget and stopping
offline Phase 2 CLI, schemas, isolated dependency lock and stable exit-code implementation
known-answer, null, injected-bias, negative-control, leakage, tamper, mixing and recovery qualification evidence
all preregistered historical statistics, effects, intervals, adjusted evidence and limitations by game and segment
registered FWER, valid Monte Carlo intervals, simultaneous power bands, delta-star, required-n and actual generation-segment sample-size envelopes for every bias family and effect parameter
same-code reproducibility replay, independent-reference deterministic recomputation and different-seed delta-star and required-n replay report with declared independence level
acceptance_methods: independent reference calculation for critical deterministic statistics

deliverables.definition: human-readable method, limitations, audit, calibration, per-effect practical threshold, power envelope, delta-star, required-n or not-identified state, signal classification and supported-conclusion report
unique explicit selection of formal audit, power and replay run IDs, identities, paths and hashes
machine-readable final verdict for all deliverables, gates, delivery status and independent scientific signal status

gates.name: entry_and_preregistration
pass_conditions: P2-R00 validation exits zero with terminal P2-00A-READY before P2-01 starts
P2-01 schemas and validate-input are executable before this gate is signed
phase1 identity and baseline hashes match
input manifest and active game scope are frozen
each of the 400 draws maps to exactly one number-space segment and exactly one draw-process segment
retrospective use and forbidden-field rules are explicit

cross-draw joint null, calendar policy, per-effect practical-effect registry, test families, multiplicity, qualification positives, effect and sample-size grids, seeds, fixed-count or time-uniform Monte Carlo method, simultaneous power band, error allocation and resource budget are frozen
reviewer assignment satisfies role separation
independent method review has zero blocking findings

gates.name: input_and_rule_integrity
pass_conditions: exactly 200 DLT and 200 SSQ DrawRecord rows are statistical units
800 SourceObservation rows are used only as provenance
no live or post-freeze release is read
schemas, hashes, issue mappings and current-view revisions close
no available_at-null non-label field enters a predictive feature matrix

gates.name: harness_qualification
pass_conditions: small combinatorial worlds match exact enumeration
fixed seeds reproduce canonical outputs
all generated tickets obey range, cardinality and uniqueness invariants
leakage, rule mixing, config tampering and input mutation fail closed
negative tests cannot be recorded as PASS
every qualification_positive scenario is recovered in the preregistered direction

gates.name: historical_audit
pass_conditions: all preregistered primary, negative-control and sensitivity analyses are accounted for
effect sizes, 95 percent intervals and multiplicity-adjusted evidence are present
DLT and SSQ are reported separately
exploratory findings are isolated from primary conclusions
missing draw order and mechanism metadata are reported as limitations

gates.name: false_positive_and_power
pass_conditions: uniform-world FWER one-sided 95 percent upper bound is at most 0.06
key FWER Monte Carlo interval half width is at most 0.005
nominal 95 percent interval coverage one-sided 95 percent lower bound is at least 0.93
every registered bias family has power estimates and Monte Carlo intervals
each bias family and effect parameter has delta-star selected from a simultaneous 95 percent power lower confidence band or not_identified_within_effect_grid
each registered effect point has the smallest qualifying sample-size-grid required-n or not_identified_within_n_grid, with 100 percent result coverage and no unsimulated interpolation
the actual n for every game and generation segment is placed on its applicable power envelope; n=200 is allowed only when one generation segment covers the full game
key simultaneous power interval half width is at most 0.03; wider intervals trigger HOLD rather than unsupported interpolation

gates.name: independent_replay
pass_conditions: independent replay uses identical frozen inputs and preregistration with a different seed set
same-code deterministic artifacts match exactly and critical deterministic statistics match an independent reference calculation path
Monte Carlo results satisfy frozen replay tolerance

delta-star and required-n state comparison follows REP-04: both identified differ by at most the corresponding one grid step, both share the same not-identified state to pass, and a state mismatch holds
replay review has zero blocking findings

gates.name: final_acceptance
pass_conditions: before accept, D2-01 through D2-12 exist and their evidence hashes close
G0 through G5 are PASS
the final evidence manifest explicitly selects audit, power and replay run IDs and hashes without a latest pointer
all ten required E2E cases have exactly one aggregate result and meet their registered expected outcomes
the report separates delivery status from signal status
no prediction, betting, randomness-proof or 100-percent claim is present
accept atomically writes D2-13 only to artifacts/phase-2/acceptance/phase2-acceptance.json, after which D2-01 through D2-13 all exist
D2-13 is not required to contain its own hash

required_e2e_cases.note: a real missing external rule source is HOLD 20 and is not this injected wrong-mapping case

required_e2e_cases.first_process: controlled interruption with no normal exit

e2e_execution_contract.full_chain_rule: E2E-P2-01 writes a test acceptance under its isolated root; G6 later performs the sole formal accept

work_packages.completion: fixed P2-R00 validation exits zero with terminal P2-00A-READY; draft hash coverage and generation-rule join coverage are 100 percent; formal D2 path occupancy and formal historical result counts are zero

work_packages.start_condition: rerun P2-R00 validation and require exit zero plus P2-00A-READY
work_packages.completion: CLI, schema, error-path and actual-hardware benchmark tests pass; no G0 or G1 claim

resource_estimation_contract.formal_estimate_formula: benchmark unit cost times frozen scenario/world count times measured parallel-efficiency factor
resource_estimation_contract.normal_approximation_sanity_only: at p approximately 0.05, 95 percent half width 0.005 is about 7300 worlds; the registered valid interval method determines the formal count

decision_rules.phase_pass_formula: all IN metrics AND all CAL metrics AND all QUAL metrics AND harness qualification AND all POW metrics AND all REP metrics AND all COV metrics
decision_rules.GO: G0 through G6 PASS, all required metrics PASS and independent reviews have zero blocking findings
decision_rules.HOLD: required evidence, rule mapping, Monte Carlo precision, budget or replay tolerance is incomplete but recoverable
decision_rules.FAIL: tampering, leakage, selective deletion, invalid known-answer behavior or role-independence violation is detected

conditions: the registered effect and sample-size grids are complete
the result uses not_identified_within_effect_grid or not_identified_within_n_grid as applicable
frozen Monte Carlo precision is met

implementation_state: No Phase 2 runtime or result is claimed by this planning contract. All CLI commands and downstream deliverables are future work.
